title: MLP-Initialized Reinforcement Learning for Exit Timing in SPX Short-Straddle Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2610.13126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies exit timing for SPX short-straddle portfolios using a two-stage supervised and reinforcement-learning framework. Historical episodes first generate ex-post optimal hold/exit labels for training a multilayer perceptron (MLP) using only contemporaneously available state variables at deployment. The trained MLP then initializes reinforcement-learning actors that are fine-tuned with a risk-aware trading reward. Out-of-sample evaluation over 2024-2026 shows that the supervised MLP substantially outperforms passive holding and representative fixed-time and profit-and-loss-based exit rules. Across seven independent seeds, MLP-initialized Actor-Critic averages 37.54% cumulative return and a Sharpe ratio of 1.705, compared with 35.01% and 1.651 for the supervised MLP. Actor-Critic trained from scratch averages only 0.18% return. These findings show that oracle-guided supervised learning provides a stable foundation for reward-b

translated_title: 基于MLP初始化强化学习的SPX卖出跨式组合退出时机研究
translated_abstract: 本文采用两阶段监督学习与强化学习框架，研究SPX卖出跨式组合的退出时机问题。首先利用历史行情片段生成事后最优的持有/退出标签，仅使用部署时点可获得的状态变量来训练多层感知机（MLP）。随后用训练好的MLP初始化强化学习的Actor（执行者），并通过风险感知的交易奖励进行微调。在2024-2026年的样本外评估中，监督MLP显著优于被动持有策略以及代表性的固定时间退出规则和基于盈亏的退出规则。在七个独立随机种子下，MLP初始化的Actor-Critic平均实现37.54%的累计收益和1.705的夏普比率，而监督MLP分别为35.01%和1.651；从零开始训练的Actor-Critic平均收益仅为0.18%。这些结果表明，先知引导的监督学习为基于奖励的微调提供了稳定的基础。
tldr: 该论文提出用事后最优标签训练的MLP来初始化强化学习Actor-Critic，从而在SPX卖出跨式组合的退出时机决策中大幅提升收益和夏普比率，远优于从零训练的强化学习方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes initializing reinforcement-learning Actor-Critic agents with an MLP trained on ex-post optimal labels, substantially improving exit-timing returns and Sharpe ratios in SPX short-straddle portfolios compared with training RL from scratch.
